title: Sparse Fourier approximation
statement: For a natural number $n$, a finite family $\mathcal F$ of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and a real coefficient assigned to every subset of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, the associated sparse Fourier approximation is the real-valued function on $\{-1,1\}^n$ given by $x\mapsto\sum_{S\in\mathcal F} c(S)\chi_S(x)$, where $\chi_S(x)$ is the product of the coordinates indexed by $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal F$ is a finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
a real coefficient is specified for every subset of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
